programme.title: Pulang Malu Gak Pulang Makin Rindu (ATV)

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu (ATV)

programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. programme.title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Parasit (ATV)
programme.desc: Cika (Yuriska Patricia) terjebak dalam permainan licik Jono (Cahya Nagara), supir yang membawa masuk Aini (Bunga Elizabeth), adiknya dan Bu Siti (Koming), ibunya untuk menguasai rumah serta toko warisan orang tua Cika. Di sisi lain, Arham (Bara Valentino), penjahit yang diam-diam menyayangi Cika, tak berdaya saat Cika dipaksa menikah dengan Jono demi menutup aib palsu.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan (ATV)
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. programme.title: Pisang Crispy Jatuh Di Hati (ATV)
programme.desc: Della (Yuki Kato) yang sedang jualan pisang crispy mendadak heran ketika melihat Zacky (Naufal Samudra) tampak kebingungan ketika mobilnya yang membawa pisang nangka mogok. Saat Della mau membenarkan mobilnya, Zacky malah menertawakannya. Zacky malah nantangin Della kalau berhasil akan ia memberi satu karung pisang nangka. Ternyata Della mampu dan membuat Zacky memberikan satu karung pisang nangka. Della senang karena bisa ia jual namun kakinya langsung lemas manakala gerobak jualannya hilang dicuri. Della menyalahkan Zacky karena telah membuat semua ini terjadi.

Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories (ATV)
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories (ATV)
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: Kai Havertz : The Big Interview (ATV)
programme.desc: As a young boy cheering from the terraces of his hometown club, Alemannia Aachen, Kai Havertz fell in love with a striker by the name of Erik Meijer. In this Extended version of the first Masterclass of the new season, Havertz' footballing icon surprises him at training, before the two share tricks of the trade on the art of forward play, recreating some of the Arsenal striker's best goals.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview (ATV)
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview (ATV)
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.desc: Marc Guehi arrived at Manchester City as an FA Cup winner with Crystal Palace before winning the same trophy with his new club 12 months later. The centre-back sits down with The Big Interview to talk about becoming a key figure in Enzo Maresca's team, as well as how a love for music has formed a key part of his life.

programme.title: Alan Shearer : The Big Interview (ATV)
programme.desc: Alan Shearer reflects on a childhood where his eye for goal came naturally, and led to a career that ended with him setting a Premier League goalscoring record that remains unchallenged. The former Southampton, Blackburn and Newcastle man explains what makes a great striker, and reveals a piece of advice that he's passed on to a Premier League star of today

programme.title: (Subbed) Fabricio Coloccini : PL Stories (ATV)
programme.desc: We head to Chile to catch up with former Newcastle United captain Fabricio Coloccini, where he is forging a new path in coaching. He reflects on life in the dugout and looks back on an unforgettable Premier League career that made him a cult hero on Tyneside.

programme.title: Kevin Keegan : PL Stories (ATV)
programme.desc: From fearless forward to one of English football's most inspirational figures, this is the story of Kevin Keegan. We chart his remarkable playing career with Liverpool, Hamburg and England before exploring his impact as a manager, where he inspired Newcastle United to become one of the Premier League's most captivating teams. Through triumphs, setbacks and an unwavering passion for the game, we celebrate the life and legacy of a true football icon.

programme.title: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink : PL Moments (ATV)
programme.desc: Over a nine season spell in the Premier League, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink etched his name into footballing folklore as one of the most dynamic goalscorers in the competition's history. Fourth all time in Premier League goals for Chelsea, Hasselbaink's iconic freekicks and powerful finishes have seen him score some of the League's most memorable goals. This week, the Dutch international sits down with PL Moments to break down how to strike the ball, and talk us through his ten favourite moments from his Premier League career.

programme.title: Petr Cech : PL Stories (ATV)
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: The Evolution Of Goalkeepers : PL Stories (ATV)

programme.title: Kesetiaan (ATV)
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN
